scripts.build: pnpm build:runtime && pnpm docs:build && pnpm --filter @stablemates/workhorse-demo build && pnpm python:build
scripts.demo:production: pnpm build && WORKHORSE_DEMO_MODE=production tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx scripts/dev.ts
scripts.signoz:up: foundryctl cast --file ops/signoz/casting.yaml --pours ops/signoz/pours && tsx scripts/signoz-portless.ts add && pnpm signoz:dashboards
scripts.signoz:down: docker compose -f ops/signoz/pours/deployment/compose.yaml down && tsx scripts/signoz-portless.ts remove
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.typecheck.json && pnpm docs:typecheck && pnpm python:typecheck && pnpm go:vet
scripts.test: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run && pnpm python:test && pnpm go:test
scripts.test:unit: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.unit.config.ts && pnpm python:test:unit && pnpm go:test:unit
scripts.test:database: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.database.config.ts && pnpm python:test:database && pnpm go:test:database
scripts.test:database:typescript: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.database.config.ts
scripts.test:database:changed: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.database.config.ts
scripts.test:protocol: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.database.config.ts typescript/core/test/sql-protocol-conformance.test.ts typescript/core/test/schema-migrations.test.ts
scripts.readme-alignment:check: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run scripts/readme-alignment.test.ts
scripts.test:changed: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:packed: pnpm build && pnpm test:build-check && tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx typescript/core/test/packed-packages.ts
scripts.test:demo-smoke: pnpm build && pnpm test:build-check && tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx typescript/core/test/demo-smoke.ts
scripts.test:site-smoke: pnpm docs:build && tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx typescript/core/test/site-smoke.ts
scripts.example:agentic-flow: pnpm build:runtime && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node typescript/examples/agentic-flow.mjs
scripts.health: tsx scripts/with-env.ts sh -c 'WORKHORSE_DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL_PRIMARY" exec tsx typescript/core/src/cli/workhorse.ts health --json'
scripts.health:bench: tsx scripts/with-env.ts sh -c 'WORKHORSE_DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL_BENCH" exec tsx typescript/core/src/cli/workhorse.ts health --json'
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --import-plugin --vitest-plugin typescript dashboard site scripts vitest*.config.ts && pnpm lint:dead-code && pnpm python:lint && pnpm go:lint
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --import-plugin --vitest-plugin typescript dashboard site scripts vitest*.config.ts
scripts.npm:lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --import-plugin --vitest-plugin typescript dashboard scripts vitest*.config.ts && pnpm lint:dead-code
scripts.npm:test:unit: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.python:format: uv run --project python ruff format python/src python/tests python/examples
scripts.python:format:check: uv run --project python ruff format --check python/src python/tests python/examples
scripts.python:lint: uv run --project python ruff check python/src python/tests python/examples
scripts.python:typecheck: uv run --project python mypy python/src/workhorse python/tests/typecheck_usage.py python/examples
scripts.python:test: tsx scripts/with-env.ts uv run --project python pytest python/tests
scripts.python:test:unit: tsx scripts/with-env.ts uv run --project python pytest -m 'not integration and not slow' python/tests
scripts.python:test:database: tsx scripts/with-env.ts uv run --project python pytest -m integration python/tests
scripts.go:lint: tsx scripts/with-env.ts go -C go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@v0.7.0 ./...
scripts.go:vuln: tsx scripts/with-env.ts go -C go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 ./...
scripts.check: pnpm sql-catalogues:check && pnpm dashboard-spec:check && pnpm dashboard-bundle:check && pnpm parity:check && pnpm readme-alignment:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm python:vuln && pnpm go:vuln && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:runtime && pnpm test && pnpm go:test:race && pnpm test:packed && pnpm test:site-smoke && pnpm test:demo-smoke
scripts.db:reset:all: pnpm db:reset:dev-primary && pnpm db:reset:dev-secondary && pnpm db:reset:test && pnpm db:reset:bench && pnpm db:reset:test-packed
